findings.title: MockDstIO.randomId() not fully deterministic — violates PRNG contract
findings.challenge: Plan.md line 129 specifies 'randomId: UUID v4 from PRNG' (fully deterministic from seeded PRNG). Creative.md line 67 says 'seedable.' However, MockDstIO.ts lines 250-254 implement randomId() as: `const hex = Math.floor(this.nextPrng() * 0xffffffff).toString(16).padStart(8, '0'); return \`${hex}-${randomUUID().slice(9)}\`;` — only the first 8 hex chars (5%) come from the PRNG; the remaining 28 chars come from real `crypto.randomUUID()`. This means two DST sessions with the same seed produce DIFFERENT randomId values for the 28 non-deterministic characters, breaking the core DST property of full replay reproducibility.
findings.alternative: Replace with fully PRNG-based UUID v4 generator: generate all 32 hex characters from xoshiro128** PRNG (consuming 16 x 32-bit PRNG values per UUID), format as UUID v4 with correct version (4) and variant bits (10xx), returning a fully deterministic UUID.
findings.risk: Any test using randomId() will be non-deterministic and unreproducible between runs. As DST harness adoption grows (Phases 3-6), this latent non-determinism will cause flaky tests that pass/fail depending on real crypto entropy. Severity: MEDIUM, Likelihood: HIGH (any code path using randomId under DST).

findings.title: MockDstIO.stat() does not resolve symlinks (carry-forward from previous review)
findings.challenge: MockDstIO.statImpl when called with isLstat=false (stat) does not check the symlinks map — it only checks this.files. When a path exists only as a symlink entry (via addSymlink) with no corresponding file entry, stat() throws ENOENT. On a real filesystem, stat() follows symlinks to the target file.
findings.alternative: Enhance statImpl's `isLstat=false` path to check symlinks map, resolve the target path via addSymlink mapping, and return the target file's stats if it exists.
findings.risk: If future code uses stat() (not just lstat) in a DST-testable path, MockDstIO would produce different results than a real filesystem.

findings.title: createNode() duplicates metadata parsing logic (carry-forward from previous review)
findings.challenge: DependencyManager.createNode() has two code paths: (a) the DstIO-aware path (lines 256-269) that re-reads file content via fsReadFile and manually parses metadata via MetadataManager.parseMetadata/validateMetadata, and (b) the non-DstIO path (lines 270-274) that delegates to MetadataManager.getPublicationStatus/getPublicationInfo. The DstIO-aware path duplicates parsing logic that already exists in those MetadataManager static methods.
findings.alternative: Refactor MetadataManager.getPublicationStatus and getPublicationInfo to accept an optional DstIO parameter, or add a static factory method taking content string instead of file path, so the DstIO-aware path can reuse them.
findings.risk: Low in current scope — both paths work correctly. Maintenance divergence risk over time as metadata rules evolve.
